markLogic.description: Wordmark 'Replit' + name derives from REPL acronym (Read-Eval-Print-Loop).
markLogic.encoding: The product is the loop: describe -> build -> run -> iterate, closing back on itself.
markLogic.diagramReading: If the mark were a diagram of the product, it would be an infinite loop with an idea entering one end and a shipped app exiting the other — returning to seed the next idea.

invertedClaim: Unlike coding tools that assume you already know how to code, Replit removes the barrier entirely — describe an idea and the app is built, deployed, and live.

tension.says: Turn ideas into apps in minutes — no coding needed.
tension.shows: Agent writes production-ready code with full-stack infrastructure (auth, database, hosting, monitoring), 100+ integrations, and enterprise controls (SSO/SAML, SOC 2).

visualRules.rule: Dark canvas as the default ground; light/inks only on the inverse.
Kind type does the work; big confident statements over photography.
One voltage accent carries every 'action' moment; it never floods a scene.
The loop motif lives in structure (state-to-state return), not decoration.
Proof beats claims: show the app built and shipped; never a static benefit sentence.
Whitespace is authority: dense for feature tours, sparse for the hook and the close.

failureModes.mode: Generic AI slideshow (purple gradients, robot emoji, 'AI!' everywhere)
failureModes.whyItRuins: Reduces Replit to a thousand identical AI-builder ads.
Kitschy, not Replit; dev nostalgia without the ship-it energy.
Replit is a ship-it tool; mythic narrative kills momentum.

failureModes.mode: Letting 'no coding' stand as a static sentence
failureModes.whyItRuins: Hides the actual product: an app conjured and shipped.
